import ThesisCommon.Analysis.BooleanStoneSeparation
import ThesisCommon.Analysis.CompactContent

/-! A finite additive Boolean content is represented by an actual measure
on its compact Boolean point space. The sigma algebra is generated by the
Boolean cylinder sets, with no second-countability assumption. -/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal Classical
namespace ThesisCommon
variable {B : Type*} [BooleanAlgebra B]

def booleanStoneAlgebra (B : Type*) [BooleanAlgebra B] : Set (Set (BooleanStonePoint B)) :=
  range booleanStoneSet

theorem booleanStoneAlgebra_isSetAlgebra : IsSetAlgebra (booleanStoneAlgebra B) where
  empty_mem := ⟨⊥, booleanStoneSet_bot⟩
  compl_mem := by
    rintro s ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨aᶜ, booleanStoneSet_compl a⟩
  union_mem := by
    rintro s t ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a ⊔ b, booleanStoneSet_sup a b⟩

instance booleanStoneMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (BooleanStonePoint B) :=
  MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (booleanStoneAlgebra B)

theorem measurableSet_booleanStoneSet (a : B) : MeasurableSet (booleanStoneSet a) :=
  MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨a, rfl⟩

def booleanStoneContentValue (c : B → ENNReal) (s : Set (BooleanStonePoint B)) : ENNReal :=
  if h : ∃ a, booleanStoneSet a = s then c h.choose else 0

theorem booleanStoneContentValue_apply (c : B → ENNReal) (a : B) :
    booleanStoneContentValue c (booleanStoneSet a) = c a := by
  rw [booleanStoneContentValue, dif_pos (show ∃ b, booleanStoneSet b = booleanStoneSet a from ⟨a, rfl⟩)]
  congr 1
  exact booleanStoneSet_injective
    (show ∃ b, booleanStoneSet b = booleanStoneSet a from ⟨a, rfl⟩).choose_spec

def booleanStoneContent (c : B → ENNReal) (hc0 : c ⊥ = 0)
    (hcadd : ∀ a b, Disjoint a b → c (a ⊔ b) = c a + c b) :
    AddContent (booleanStoneAlgebra B) :=
  booleanStoneAlgebra_isSetAlgebra.isSetRing.addContent_of_union (booleanStoneContentValue c)
    (by rw [← booleanStoneSet_bot, booleanStoneContentValue_apply, hc0]) (by
      rintro s t ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩ hab
      rw [← booleanStoneSet_sup, booleanStoneContentValue_apply,
        booleanStoneContentValue_apply, booleanStoneContentValue_apply]
      apply hcadd
      apply disjoint_iff.mpr
      apply booleanStoneSet_injective
      rw [booleanStoneSet_inf, booleanStoneSet_bot]
      exact hab.eq_bot)

theorem content_sigmaSubadditive_of_compact_clopen_algebra
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {C : Set (Set X)}
    (hC : IsSetAlgebra C) (hclopen : ∀ s ∈ C, IsClopen s)
    (c : AddContent C) : c.IsSigmaSubadditive := by
  intro f hf hUnion
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (hclopen _ hUnion).isClosed.isCompact.elim_finite_subcover f
    (fun n => (hclopen _ (hf n)).isOpen) (Subset.refl _)
  have hmem : (I.image f : Set (Set X)) ⊆ C := by
    rintro s hs
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
    exact hf i
  have hcover : (⋃ n, f n) ⊆ ⋃₀ (I.image f : Set (Set X)) := by
    simpa only [Finset.coe_image, sUnion_image, Finset.mem_coe] using hI
  calc
    c (⋃ n, f n) ≤ ∑ s ∈ I.image f, c s :=
      addContent_le_sum_of_subset_sUnion hC.isSetRing.isSetSemiring hmem hUnion hcover
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, c (f i) := Finset.sum_image_le_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le _)
    _ ≤ ∑' i, c (f i) := ENNReal.sum_le_tsum I

theorem booleanStoneContent_sigmaSubadditive (c : B → ENNReal) (hc0 : c ⊥ = 0)
    (hcadd : ∀ a b, Disjoint a b → c (a ⊔ b) = c a + c b) :
    (booleanStoneContent c hc0 hcadd).IsSigmaSubadditive := by
  apply content_sigmaSubadditive_of_compact_clopen_algebra booleanStoneAlgebra_isSetAlgebra
  rintro s ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact isClopen_booleanStoneSet a

def booleanStoneMeasure (c : B → ENNReal) (hc0 : c ⊥ = 0)
    (hcadd : ∀ a b, Disjoint a b → c (a ⊔ b) = c a + c b) : Measure (BooleanStonePoint B) :=
  (booleanStoneContent c hc0 hcadd).measure booleanStoneAlgebra_isSetAlgebra.isSetRing.isSetSemiring
    le_rfl (booleanStoneContent_sigmaSubadditive c hc0 hcadd)

theorem booleanStoneMeasure_apply (c : B → ENNReal) (hc0 : c ⊥ = 0)
    (hcadd : ∀ a b, Disjoint a b → c (a ⊔ b) = c a + c b) (a : B) :
    booleanStoneMeasure c hc0 hcadd (booleanStoneSet a) = c a := by
  rw [booleanStoneMeasure, (booleanStoneContent c hc0 hcadd).measure_eq
    booleanStoneAlgebra_isSetAlgebra.isSetRing.isSetSemiring rfl
    (booleanStoneContent_sigmaSubadditive c hc0 hcadd)
    (show booleanStoneSet a ∈ booleanStoneAlgebra B from ⟨a, rfl⟩)]
  exact booleanStoneContentValue_apply c a

theorem isFiniteMeasure_booleanStoneMeasure (c : B → ENNReal) (hc0 : c ⊥ = 0)
    (hcadd : ∀ a b, Disjoint a b → c (a ⊔ b) = c a + c b) (hctop : c ⊤ ≠ ⊤) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (booleanStoneMeasure c hc0 hcadd) where
  measure_univ_lt_top := by
    rw [← booleanStoneSet_top, booleanStoneMeasure_apply]
    exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hctop

end ThesisCommon
